info.name: Adobe Lightroom Lightroom Services API
Health
Adobe Lightroom Get Api Health Status

items.docs: Returns the health status of the Lightroom Services API. This endpoint does not require authentication and can be used to verify API availability.

info.name: Catalog
Adobe Lightroom Get the Customer's Catalog

items.docs: Retrieves the catalog metadata for the authenticated Lightroom customer. Each customer has a single catalog that contains all their assets and albums. The catalog_id returned is used as a path parameter in most other API calls.

info.name: Adobe Lightroom Get Catalog by Id

params.name: catalog_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the Lightroom catalog

items.docs: Retrieves catalog metadata for a specific catalog by its identifier.

info.name: Assets
Adobe Lightroom List Assets in a Catalog

params.name: catalog_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the Lightroom catalog

params.name: subtype
params.description: Filter assets by subtype

params.name: captured_after
params.description: Filter assets captured after this ISO 8601 timestamp

params.name: captured_before
params.description: Filter assets captured before this ISO 8601 timestamp

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of results to skip for pagination

items.docs: Retrieves a paginated list of assets in the specified catalog. Assets represent individual photos or videos. Results can be filtered by subtype and capture date.

info.name: Adobe Lightroom Get a Specific Asset

params.name: catalog_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the Lightroom catalog

params.name: asset_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the asset

items.docs: Retrieves metadata for a specific asset including EXIF data, develop settings, and available renditions.

info.name: Adobe Lightroom Create or Update an Asset

params.name: catalog_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the Lightroom catalog

params.name: asset_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the asset

items.docs: Creates a new asset revision or updates an existing asset in the catalog. Used to upload new photos or update metadata on existing ones.

info.name: Adobe Lightroom Upload the Master (original) File for an Asset

params.name: catalog_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the Lightroom catalog

params.name: asset_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the asset

items.docs: Uploads the original master file for a previously created asset. The asset must already exist in the catalog. The request body should contain the binary image data.

info.name: Adobe Lightroom Get the Develop Settings Xmp for an Asset

params.name: catalog_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the Lightroom catalog

params.name: asset_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the asset

items.docs: Retrieves the external develop XMP sidecar file for the specified asset. Contains Lightroom develop settings as XMP metadata.

info.name: Adobe Lightroom Upload Develop Settings Xmp for an Asset

params.name: catalog_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the Lightroom catalog

params.name: asset_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the asset

items.docs: Uploads an external develop XMP sidecar file for the specified asset, applying Lightroom develop settings.

info.name: Renditions
Adobe Lightroom Get an Asset Rendition

params.name: catalog_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the Lightroom catalog

params.name: asset_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the asset

params.name: rendition_type
params.description: Type of rendition to retrieve. Specifies the size of the generated preview image.

items.docs: Retrieves a generated rendition (preview image) for the specified asset. The rendition_type parameter specifies the size and format. Renditions are generated server-side from the master file.

info.name: Albums
Adobe Lightroom List Albums in a Catalog

params.name: catalog_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the Lightroom catalog

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of results to skip for pagination

items.docs: Retrieves a paginated list of albums in the specified catalog. Albums are collections of assets organized by the user.

info.name: Adobe Lightroom Get a Specific Album

params.name: catalog_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the Lightroom catalog

params.name: album_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the album

items.docs: Retrieves metadata for a specific album including its name, cover asset, creation date, and update timestamps.

info.name: Adobe Lightroom Create or Update an Album

params.name: catalog_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the Lightroom catalog

params.name: album_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the album

items.docs: Creates a new album or updates an existing album in the catalog.

info.name: Adobe Lightroom Delete an Album

params.name: catalog_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the Lightroom catalog

params.name: album_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the album

items.docs: Deletes the specified album from the catalog. This does not delete the assets within the album.

info.name: Adobe Lightroom List Assets in an Album

params.name: catalog_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the Lightroom catalog

params.name: album_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the album

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of results to skip for pagination

items.docs: Retrieves a paginated list of assets contained within the specified album.

info.name: Adobe Lightroom Add Assets to an Album

params.name: catalog_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the Lightroom catalog

params.name: album_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the album

items.docs: Adds one or more existing assets to the specified album. The assets must already exist in the catalog.
